summary: Russian forces launched multiple missile and drone strikes on Kyiv, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions, with Ukrainian UAVs targeting Russian logistics. Frontline clashes persist in Kursk and Belgorod, while energy infrastructure remains under attack.
key_points: Russian missile strikes on Kyiv caused power outages (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69594)
Ukrainian UAVs attacked Nova Poshta warehouses in Kharkov, Poltava, and Vinnytsa (Source: @tass_agency/388180)
Russian troops advanced near Dobropolye in Sumy direction (Source: @tass_agency/388194)
Ukrainian UAVs struck residential areas in Belgorod, injuring civilians (Source: @tass_agency/388176)
Russian Ministry of Defense reported liberation of Styenki village in Kursk (Source: @tass_agency/388175)
Ukrainian strikes on Kursk region injured three civilians (Source: @tass_agency/388176)
Russian forces consolidated positions in Zaporozhye region (Source: @tass_agency/388194)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain aggressive strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure and logistics, while Ukrainian UAV operations target Russian supply chains. Frontline clashes in Kursk and Belgorod indicate sustained operational pressure, with potential for escalation in eastern and southern regions.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian authorities report increased UAV activity against Russian logistics, while Russian strikes on energy infrastructure aim to disrupt civilian and military operations. Regional governments emphasize preparedness for continued attacks on critical infrastructure.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military operations focus on disrupting Ukrainian logistics and energy systems, with targeted strikes on Nova Poshta warehouses and gas stations. Ukrainian UAV campaigns against Russian positions in Kursk and Belgorod suggest efforts to degrade enemy capabilities. Sustained attacks on Kyiv and Kharkiv regions highlight strategic priorities for both sides.
